Exhibition marking Victory Day at Barisal
2017-12-20T00:00:00+06:00 | Sushanta Ghosh
https://www.thedailystar.net/arts-entertainment/exhibition/exhibition-marking-victory-day-2017-barisal-1507357

A daylong exhibition about facts, photos, documents of Liberation War was held to observe the 46th anniversary of Victory of Bangladesh in Barisal on Saturday .

Barisal Reporters Unity (BRU) arranged the eleventh exhibition about on the Liberation War at Ansar VDP range office in Bangabandhu Udyan premises on occasion of Victory Day, patronised by district administration.

It was inaugurated by Md.Shahiduzzaman, divisional commissioner and Habibur Rahman, deputy commissioner of Barisal and attended by leading freedom fighters, local elites, and BRU officials on Saturday morning.

This exhibition drew attentions of a huge number of spectators, especially Freedom Fighters and young visitors. A documentary film show on the history of Bangladesh was shown there.
